paper_title: Dynamic Time Warping Under Translation: Approximation Guided by Space-Filling Curves
statement: Our restriction to directed grid graphs might turn out significantly simpler than general planar digraphs. We only ever query the distance between a single source-sink pair. Finally, if no further algorithmic improvements can be found, can we give improved conditional hardness results, going beyond our reduction from DTW for a fixed translation?
